messages.text:
"IMPORTANT: The game must use the exact gameplay perspective of Project Zomboid.

Create a 3D isometric survival game with an elevated camera angle looking down at the world, similar to Project Zomboid.

CAMERA:

- Fixed isometric perspective.
- Camera follows the player smoothly.
- Entire character and surrounding environment remain visible.
- Buildings must support visible interiors.

GAMEPLAY:

- Free movement in eight directions.
- Walk, run and sneak.
- Enter and explore buildings.
- Open doors, windows and containers.
- Search furniture, shelves, vehicles and corpses.
- Pick up, equip, drop and organize items.
- Limited inventory with weight.
- Zombies detect the player through sight and sound.
- Melee combat and firearm combat.
- Health, hunger, thirst, fatigue and injuries.
- Vehicles that can be entered and driven.

VISUALS:
Realistic 3D environments, detailed buildings, abandoned streets, realistic characters, atmospheric lighting and zombie apocalypse atmosphere.

Do not use a third-person chase camera or a first-person camera. The isometric camera and Project Zomboid-style gameplay are essential.

Build functional mechanics instead of visual placeholders.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
